item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be a few showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the coast of Guangxi. The anticyclone aloft covering the northern part of the South China Sea is expected to strengthen midweek this week. The weather will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be more showers with thunderstorms over southern China in the latter part of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Khanun will linger over the seas south of Kyushu of Japan in the next couple of days. It will take a northerly track and move across Kyushu afterwards.
